description: Find publication-cleared FX industry organisations by name or service, optionally within a business category. Returns at most ten directory references with canonical citation URLs; does not rank firms or export the database. Access: public directory references, no API key required.

category.description: Exact business category ID from directory results; omit to search all categories.

query.description: Organisation name or service search, 2-120 characters, e.g. currency exchange.

name: organisation_search
title: Find FX Industry Organisations
